warning.titlePre: Mercedes GLE Coupe Known Issues by Engine
paragraphs: OM642 (diesel V6, GLE Coupe 300d/350d models) If your GLE Coupe has the OM642 diesel V6, swirl flap and injector wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine, backed by multiple manufacturer technical service bulletins. We replace worn swirl flaps, injector seals and timing chain components as standard on every OM642 rebuild.

AMG V8 (M157/M177, GLE63 Coupe) If your GLE Coupe is the GLE63 AMG — with either the earlier M157 or current M177 V8 — valve seal and coolant system wear are established AMG specialist patterns. We inspect and replace valve seals and coolant components as standard on every AMG V8 rebuild.
warning.source: Source: established specialist pattern, multiple TSBs (OM642) / AMG specialist pattern (M157/M177). Current V167 mainstream range not independently confirmed per VRF
